title: Boundary theorems for geometric coding trees
exact_target: Determine which results about approaching the boundary through a Riemann map also hold when the approach is through branches of a geometric coding tree.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300057 (AMR-052-0057). CC BY 4.0.

Feliks Przytycki, ``On Invariant Measures for Iterations of Holomorphic Maps'', in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (eds.), Problems in Holomorphic Dynamics (1992), Problem 2.6, pp. 33; arXiv:math/9205209v1.
